logged.notes: so tired today. i also worked out without eating

thread.text:
Today: Incline Bench Press tested the 67.5kg table load for the first time since it was earned on 09-28, giving 7, 7, 7 — in the 5-8 band, but one working set short of the four prescribed before the 50kg x8 back-off. Pull-ups ran second as instructed, first outing with the +5kg since 10-26, landing 8, 8, 8 for 24 total. Chest Fly held 65kg for 10, 10 then an extra set at 6. Reverse Fly came in a touch light at 42.5kg x10, 8. Lateral Raise went back to 7kg x15, 15, 15 rather than the 8kg called for across all three sets. One Handed Triceps Pull sat at 10kg x10, 10, 10. Given the note — tired, no food — the session held up well through the first two slots before softening.

Heart rate: 57 minutes start to end, average 106, range 82-139. Most of the time sat in the 90s and 100s (16.8 and 14.9 min), with only brief spells above 120. Against the week's other two lifting sessions — 78 min at 102 avg/148 max on 11-05, 42 min at 104 avg/136 max on 11-07 — today's average ran slightly higher for less total time, which fits training on an empty stomach.

Trend: 67.5kg incline is now live but the full four-set target isn't locked in yet — track it against 10-26's 65kg x8, 8. Pull-ups at +5kg, slot 2, gave 24 reps, right in the 24-32 range that slot has produced before. One Handed Triceps Pull has now read 10, 10, 10 twice running (10-26 and today) — 12s on all sets is what moves it to the next step.

Next session: Upper C, Sat 14 Nov. Carry in Chest Supported Row at 20kg after 11-07's 12, 12, 12, Bench Press (Dumbbell) back to 28kg, and Face Pull back to 17.5kg.
